semantic_assessment.coordinate_measurement: Full-frame BOX_ONLY MobileSAM mask supplies sampled transitions/two fitted incident lines. Intersection covariance controls bounded sigma2 blend only, not solver visibility/accuracy weights.
semantic_assessment.independence: Observations originate from actual image evidence; local line search and box still depend on detector q. Image-origin evidence is not statistical independence, and adjacent corrected corners share fitted edges.
semantic_assessment.excluded_support: Hidden, missing, original OOB and center preserved by wrapper; exact original eligibility copied into fit-independent mask. Hidden projections are output completion only.
semantic_assessment.physical_basis: Nonidentity Q=R_cf0.T@R_physical0 retained with asymmetric registered dimensions; output R_physical=R_cf_final@Q, cf_extents/order unchanged.
semantic_assessment.fallback: Below four credible actual observations retains exact original pose and raw completion; corrected measurements may remain diagnostic output but do not imply a refined pose.
semantic_assessment.format: Native8/9 points supported; center never fit or changed; missing nonfinite points serialize as null and stayexcluded.
semantic_assessment.default: Optional new class/config; original main visibility model and default numeric solver setting remainunchanged.
